independent_pixel_review.manual: Fig105 supports tube4 containing straight input shaft6 and 90-degree lower bevel transmission. The broad upper-left element in the diagram is bracket5, not a wheel-plane orientation datum.
independent_pixel_review.photo_direction: With native front=-X, observed lower-column-forward / upper-hub-rearward trend is consistent with upward-axis +X. No calibrated pitch magnitude or target543A batch proof.
hypothesis_limits: The probe rotates the entire wheel group about its centre by about34.377 degrees, not a180-degree face inversion
The probe preserves wheel centre and column bottom Z only; bottom X changes and the tube is axially scaled, so it does not preserve a known reducer hardpoint
PCA gives an unoriented ring plane normal; choosing positive Z does not verify wheel front/back, hub dish or actual mechanical input direction
The offset column-mounted selector/lever hardware visible in the photograph must not be parented as a wheel-rotation child without source evidence
independent_pixel_review.decision: Retain opposite-lean as an independent photo-consistent hypothesis only; no factory installation repair accepted
